title: feat: add Discord username field to community model allowlist template
author: YoannDev90
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

Adds an optional Discord username input field to the Community Model Publisher Allowlist issue template.

Closes #12653

## Changes

- Added optional `discord-username` input field after `relevant-links` and before `availability`
- Field is optional to avoid blocking submissions from applicants not yet in the Discord server
- Placeholder text: `your-discord-username`

## Why

After approval, the community monitor bot (`el405b`) needs the applicant's Discord snowflake ID to ping them about their models. Currently this requires a manual round-trip. This field captures the human-readable username upfront, so the snowflake ID can be resolved via member lookup during the post-approval workflow.

## Note

I would have personally made this field mandatory — the Discord username is essential to the post-approval workflow. But based on the pattern of the other fields in the form (model types, publishing plans, availability = required; relevant links = optional), keeping it optional is logically consistent and avoids blocking submissions from applicants not yet in the Discord server.
